title: Agent Toolkit Loop Template
description: Schema for loop.yaml — the loop template manifest for agent-toolkit recurring automation loops

name.description: Unique kebab-case identifier for the loop template

description.description: Short human-readable description of what the loop does and its tier

tier.description: Safety tier: L1=read-only or propose-only, L2=limited writes PR-gated, L3=full write access

cadence.description: How often the loop runs, expressed as a number followed by m (minutes), h (hours), or d (days)

goal.description: Declarative statement of what success looks like. The loop stops when this is achieved or budget is exhausted.

allowlist.description: Explicit list of permitted mutation actions. Empty array means read-only (L1 typical).

items.description: Action name (e.g. comment, label, merge, create_draft_pr)

deny.description: Explicit list of prohibited actions. The loop must never attempt these.

items.description: Prohibited action name (e.g. merge, approve, force-push)

exit_conditions.description: Conditions under which the loop terminates normally. Evaluated after each iteration.

budget.description: Resource constraints that prevent runaway token or time consumption

max_tokens.description: Maximum total tokens (prompt + completion) allowed per run

max_runs_per_day.description: Maximum number of times this loop may execute in a 24-hour window

max_wall_seconds.description: Maximum wall-clock seconds a single run may consume before forced termination

max_iterations.description: Maximum number of agent iterations (tool calls) allowed within a single run

verifier.description: Agent or skill name to invoke as a post-run quality gate before results are accepted. Null disables verification.

oneOf.description: Agent or skill name (e.g. code-reviewer, security-reviewer)

resumable.description: Whether the loop writes STATE.md checkpoints so it can resume from the last processed item after interruption

request.description: The full prompt/instructions passed to the agent at each run. Should be self-contained and include all steps.
